ui.header.title: Mantella
ui.setting.game.name: Game
ui.setting.game.description: Choose the game to run with Mantella.
ui.setting.skyrim_mod_folder.name: {game}: Path to Mantella Spell Mod
ui.setting.skyrim_mod_folder.description:
If you are using Mod Organizer 2, right-click the Mantella mod in your mod list and select "Open in Explorer".
If you are using Vortex, specify the {game}\Data folder.
For example: {example_path}.
If this path is incorrect, NPCs will repeat the same voice line.
